column1: # Example: E. coli K-12 genes whose CRISPRi (dCas9) silencing in the MG1655-derived strain FR-E01 protects cells from lysis by phage 186 (186-cIts), i.e. phage host factors such as LPS core (waa/rfa) biosynthesis genes; genome-wide sgRNA library, 2 h infection.

# Source: Rousset F, Cui L, Siouve E, et al. (2018) Genome-wide CRISPR-dCas9 screens in E. coli identify essential genes and phage host factors. PLoS Genet 14(11):e1007749. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pgen.1007749

# Source file: pgen.1007749.s015.csv (S5 Table, gene resistance scores after phage screens) (https://journals.plos.org/plosgenetics/article/file?id=10.1371/journal.pgen.1007749.s015&type=supplementary)

# Cutoff: genes targeted by more than 1 guide with a resistance score (median log2FC of coding-strand guides) greater than 20% of the maximum score for the phage (paper's Fig 4B selection); 88 genes pass for phage 186 (maximum score 3.880); lambda and T4 scores of the same genes shown for comparison
